description: This file contains utility functions for handling and validating schemas within Apache Spark's SQL module, including schema comparison, column path resolution, and duplication checks.

classes.name: SchemaUtils.ColumnPath
classes.description: Represents a nested column path within a schema, with methods for string representation and prepending parts.

methods.name: findColumnPaths
methods.description: Recursively finds all column paths in a DataType that satisfy a predicate.

methods.name: checkSchemaColumnNameDuplication
methods.description: Checks for duplicate column names in a schema, throws exception if duplicates are found.

methods.name: checkColumnNameDuplication
methods.description: Checks for duplicate column names in a list, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: explodeNestedFieldNames
methods.description: Flattens nested schema fields into a list of dot-separated column names.

methods.name: findColumnPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of a column in a schema, including nested fields.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Retrieves the column name(s) from a position path within a schema.

methods.name: restoreOriginalOutputNames
methods.description: Restores original column names in a list of NamedExpressions.

methods.name: escapeMetaCharacters
methods.description: Escapes special meta characters in a string.

methods.name: hasNonUTF8BinaryCollation
methods.description: Checks if a DataType contains non-UTF8 binary collation string types.

methods.name: hasIndeterminateCollation
methods.description: Checks if a DataType contains indeterminate string collation.

methods.name: checkIndeterminateCollationInSchema
methods.description: Throws an error if the schema contains indeterminate collation.

methods.name: checkNoCollationsInMapKeys
methods.description: Ensures map keys do not have collated string types.

methods.name: replaceCollatedStringWithString
methods.description: Replaces collated StringType with non-collated StringType recursively.

methods.name: validateSchemaCompatibility
methods.description: Validates if two schemas are compatible under a given mode.

methods.name: validateTypeCompatibility
methods.description: Recursively checks type and nullability compatibility between schema fields.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats a schema field as a string for error messages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Creates a map from field names to StructField objects, considering case sensitivity.
